name: com.theitalianwinemap/wine-map
title: The Italian Wine Map
description: Italian wine guide: every DOCG, DOC and IGT, crus, grapes, producers, scored reviews, vintage charts

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find Italian wine regions, denominations (DOCG, DOC, IGT), crus and subzones (MGAs, UGAs, contrade), grape varieties, producers and wine reviews on The Italian Wine Map by name. Use it first when unsure of the exact name or spelling.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "Cannubi", "nerello", "Brunello", "Produttori del Barbaresco".

type.description: Limit to one kind of result. Default any.

tools.name: get_appellation
tools.description: The full guide to an Italian wine region (e.g. Piedmont), denomination (e.g. Barolo DOCG, Etna DOC, Chianti Classico) or cru/subzone (e.g. Cannubi, Rabajà, Panzano): what the wine is, legal rules (grapes, minimum aging, Riserva), soils, altitude, communes, its crus or subzones, vintage ratings and the best-rated reviews. Written from the official production rules (disciplinari) and the reference books.

tools.name: get_grape
tools.description: Guide to an Italian grape variety (about 250 covered, from Nebbiolo and Sangiovese to rarities like Pignolo or Timorasso): origin, character, where it is grown (the denominations that use it) and reviews of wines made from it.

tools.name: get_producer
tools.description: Profile of an Italian wine estate reviewed on the site: style, key vineyards, the denominations it makes, and every review of its wines with scores.

tools.name: find_reviews
tools.description: List wine reviews of Italian wines by Orazio Campoli (100-point scale), filtered by appellation, cru, region, grape, producer, vintage and minimum score. Use it for recommendations ("best Barolo 2021", "Etna wines over 93 points", "Nebbiolo outside Piedmont").

tools.name: get_review
tools.description: The full text of one wine review: score, tasting note, producer, appellation, grapes and where to buy it.

review.description: The review id, its URL slug, or the wine name with vintage, e.g. "2021 Brovia Villero Barolo".

tools.name: get_vintage_chart
tools.description: Year-by-year vintage ratings (1-5 stars) with a note on each growing season and whether the wine is released yet, for the main Italian appellations (Barolo, Barbaresco, Brunello, Chianti Classico, Amarone, Etna, Taurasi and more).
